title: 1860 Great Meteor
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1860 Great Meteor", at revision 1374844585, opens: "The 1860 Great Meteor procession occurred on July 20, 1860. It was an extremely rare meteoric phenomenon reported from locations across the United States." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11777686, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Earth-grazing meteor procession seen across the United States". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
